description: Delete a pricing function your workspace owns, for good. Built-in functions and other workspaces' functions cannot be deleted. To stop routing to one without losing it, set its status to inactive with update_function instead. Needs a Last Price credential with function publish scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

function_id.description: The pricing function UUID: id on a list_functions result.

name: delete_function
